name: Linked
summary: A Condition that ties Movement of two or more things. When A is Linked to B, A moves where and when B does.

extra.Soft Linkages: In the case of Links by a flexible and non-vital implement like a rope, Links "remember" the length. A and B may move freely within that Distance, but drag one another to preserve that maximum Distance.
extra.Limits of Weight: When something is linked to a Creature, and it lacks the ability to lift it, its Movement is halved. If the Creature would be unable to even pull something Linked to it, they become Restrained.

name: Frenzied
summary:
At the start of each Turn, you roll a Chaos Die, suffering the consequences according to your roll:
You may act as normal.
You must take at least 1 genuinely hostile Action like an Attack or other real harm against the nearest Creature.
You must spend all your AP attempting to cause as much harm as possible to the nearest Creature.
